question: Does a label-free ball-out-of-play correction of the frozen dead-ball mask raise exposed-development feed_like_v2 spell F1 above 0.60 without regressing clean/v1 spell or short recall?

diagnostics_on_exposed_development_cells: An oracle dead-ball mask with unchanged H/A adds 0.07-0.09 spell F1 per inspected cell.
On Sportec, 17-21% of reference possessions are lost because the frozen mask predicts D over them; most are short spells just before a stoppage.
When the ball is observed outside the pitch the reference D starts within about 0.1-0.2 s (Sportec, Metrica); the ball is outside on 0.5-1% of observed live frames and 59-76% of observed dead frames.
Uniform D edge shifts (42 settings) and P(D)-thresholded edge trims (24 settings) were explored first and none improved the three spell means; they are not candidates.
motivation.disclosure: These diagnostics read development labels to locate the failure. The rule itself and its two constants were written before any ball-exit candidate was scored.
motivation.challenge_feed_applicability: Label-free check: the challenge ball is outside the pitch on 4.4% of observed frames in 104 episodes.

rule.delay: a predicted D run that starts while the ball is observed inside the pitch, followed within 5 s by an outside observation, starts at that first outside observation
rule.force: frames with the ball observed outside are dead, held until the ball is next observed inside or an existing D run begins, at most 3 s
rule.inputs: ball position and pitch size only; no speed or stillness; no labels; no fitting

candidates.fixed: approved frontier H/A mixture 0.5/0.375/0.125, H/A cost 3, decoded inside the edited live spans

evaluation: 35 cells; five exposed development matches; clean 1, feed_like_v1 2, feed_like_v2 4 realizations; realizations within match, matches within provider, providers equally
success: a retained candidate with feed_like_v2 spell_f1 > 0.60
known_limits: Sportec keeps stoppage ball coordinates, so outside observations persist through its dead periods; the rule reads position only, but the force edit can benefit from that persistence and is reported separately from delay
feed_like_v2 removes ball observations with state-dependent rates placed using development labels
no GAR, organizer or public scoring
not_allowed: changing constants, margins or rules after seeing results without a new declaration
